title: Servicing of Northgate Credit Cards Accounts by Meridian Trust Bank
content:
Program partnership summary for Northgate Credit Cards: the account terms and the servicing matters that belong to Meridian Trust Bank.

## Principle

The account terms disclosed at opening are the bank's: the card product's annual fee while the linked membership is paid, its purchase APR, its foreign transaction fee and, on cards that offer it, promotional deferred interest for the product's promotional months on a single Northgate purchase of at least the product's promotional minimum. Statements, payments, interest, late fees, credit line changes, fraud and purchase disputes are serviced by the bank; Northgate member services explains the terms but changes none of them and records nothing on the account for them.

## Responsibility matrix

| Matter | Serviced by | Northgate member services |
|---|---|---|
| Annual fee, purchase APR, foreign transaction fee, promotional deferred interest | Meridian Trust Bank (terms disclosed at opening) | Explains the terms; changes none; records nothing on the account |
| Statements | Meridian Trust Bank | Records nothing on the account |
| Payments | Meridian Trust Bank | Records nothing on the account |
| Interest and late fees | Meridian Trust Bank | Changes none; records nothing on the account |
| Credit line changes | Meridian Trust Bank | Changes none; records nothing on the account |
| Fraud | Meridian Trust Bank | Records nothing on the account |
| Purchase disputes | Meridian Trust Bank | Records nothing on the account |

## Points of judgement

- **A cardholder asks member services to waive a late fee.** Late fees are serviced by the bank; member services changes no term and records nothing on the account for it.
- **A cardholder asks what the promotional financing on a card involves.** Member services explains the disclosed term: on a card that offers it, deferred interest for the product's promotional months on a single Northgate purchase of at least its promotional minimum.
- **A cardholder reports a charge they do not recognise, or disputes a purchase.** Fraud and purchase disputes are serviced by the bank; member services records nothing on the account for them.
